idor.name: Insecure direct object reference
idor.covers: object read or mutated by client-supplied id without ownership check

broken-access-control.name: Broken access control
broken-access-control.covers: missing or wrong role, permission, scope or tenant check that is not an id lookup

auth-bypass.name: Authentication bypass
auth-bypass.covers: login, session, token, 2FA, magic-link, passkey or API-key check that can be skipped or forged

csrf.name: Cross-site request forgery
csrf.covers: state change on a cookie-authenticated route without CSRF protection

ssrf.name: Server-side request forgery
ssrf.covers: outbound request to a user-influenced destination

injection.name: Injection
injection.covers: NoSQL/SQL/command/template/header injection, path traversal, prototype pollution

race-condition.name: Race condition
race-condition.covers: TOCTOU or non-atomic check-then-act on state a concurrent request can change in between

business-logic.name: Business-logic error
business-logic.covers: an amount, limit, discount or state-machine rule bent without breaking a technical control

secret-exposure.name: Secret exposure
secret-exposure.covers: key, token, credential or other secret value returned, logged or derivable

crypto-weakness.name: Cryptographic weakness
crypto-weakness.covers: weak randomness, predictable tokens, wrong signature verification

other.name: Other
other.covers: fits no row above; name the class in message.text
